description:
You are a Search Marketing Strategist auditing a JavaScript-heavy client website (https://quotes.toscrape.com/js/) that is suffering from indexing issues. Your goal is to quantify the 'content gap' between the raw HTML and the rendered content.

Perform the following steps:
1. Open Screaming Frog SEO Spider.
2. Configure the spider to use 'JavaScript' rendering (Configuration > Spider > Rendering).
3. Crawl 'https://quotes.toscrape.com/js/'.
4. Wait for the crawl to finish (approx. 10-15 pages).
5. Export the 'Internal - HTML' report to a CSV file in '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'. Ensure this export includes both standard metrics and 'Rendered' metrics (like Rendered Word Count).
6. Analyze the results and write a brief report to '~/Documents/SEO/reports/js_rendering_report.txt'. The report must include the total number of pages crawled, an observation about the word count differences (Original vs Rendered), and a recommendation on whether the site relies on Client-Side Rendering.
